data.name: high
text:
wellbore_instability (high)
page: DUL-010_DDR_2009-10-02.pdf#p1
cause: Wellbore washout suspected in Namsang, oversized cuttings at surface.
remedy: Adjusted mud rheology, ran wiper trips before continuing.
NPT: 12.23 h

cementing_issue (high)
page: DUL-010_DDR_2009-10-02.pdf#p1
cause: Excessive cement losses to formation while cementing across Girujan.
remedy: Staged cement job with lightweight lead slurry and full tail string.
NPT: 14.4 h

stuck_pipe (high)
page: DUL-010_DDR_2009-10-02.pdf#p1
cause: Pipe stuck while tripping through Girujan, unable to work free, torque and drag increasing prior to stick.
remedy: Worked pipe with max overpull, spotted 58 bbl pipe-lax pill, freed after 13.2 hrs.
NPT: 13.17 h

stuck_pipe (high)
page: DUL-010_DDR_2009-10-03.pdf#p1
cause: Differential sticking in Girujan, no rotation or reciprocation possible.
remedy: Reduced mud weight, spotted spotting fluid across pay zone, freed string on jarring.
NPT: 6.43 h

stuck_pipe (high)
page: DUL-010_DDR_2009-10-07.pdf#p1
cause: Differential sticking in Barail, no rotation or reciprocation possible.
remedy: Reduced mud weight, spotted spotting fluid across pay zone, freed string on jarring.

fishing_operation (high)
page: DUL-010_DDR_2009-10-07.pdf#p1
cause: Following stuck pipe in Barail, back-off performed, fish left in hole.
remedy: Ran fishing BHA, latched fish with overshot, recovered string to surface.
NPT: 6.16 h
